extracted_text: A valuable consideration, in the sense of the law, may consist either in some right, interest, profit, or benefit accruing to the one party, or some forbearance, detriment, loss, or responsibility, given, suffered, or undertaken by the other.
axiom_summary: Classical benefit-detriment definition: consideration arises from a bargained right/benefit to one party or a detriment assumed by the other.
